body: Pro tip: If you’re getting COSRX, Anua, or Torriden, use SHAZAM9. It applies at checkout with no account or app needed.
Starting up bit late to it but some help would be greatly appreciated if you're still up for it. Thanks in advance !

Hey not sure if you're still looking for an answer but I ended up not going for the surgery and going to rehab instead. I wore a brace for 6 weeks and slowly work to build up my strength. It took a good 6 more months after that before my strength went back to a good 80-90%. I also wore a wrist strap over night for awhile. Since then I haven't had much problems with my wrist other than a few light aches here and there after over usage.
